name: vuln-fixes
description: Find and patch vulnerable PHP, Node.js and self-managed GitLab runtimes across your repos. Read-only inventory first, explicit approval before edits, regression tests before and after, one focused PR per repo.

interface.shortDescription: Fix vulnerable PHP, Node and GitLab runtimes
interface.longDescription: Inventory every PHP, Node.js and self-managed GitLab runtime in your repos, stop for approval, patch to a confirmed fixed version, test inside the built image before and after, and open one focused PR per repo.
